learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 从坐标采样和算术起步，亲手搭出一门视觉课的图像流水线和模型：重采样、滤波、特征、会学习的识别器、几何与生成，并说得出每一种能回答什么、不能回答什么。
endpoint.en: Starting from coordinate sampling and arithmetic, build by hand the image pipelines and models of a vision course — resampling, filtering, features, learned recognisers, geometry and generation — and say what each can and cannot answer.

scope.zh: 本蓝图做第 0、1 章（第 1、2 讲和第 2 次 workshop）：视觉任务和一张图能提供的证据；成像（针孔投影、透镜与景深、视场、毫米与像素的换算）；数字图像的表示（数组、坐标、通道顺序、数值范围）；采样网格、最近邻与双线性缩放、量化、裁剪和宽高比。对章节规格（chapters-0-1.md）的取舍：平移移到滤波一章，第 1 章里只有一道拼凑的关用它；缩放改用像素中心对齐的约定，和 OpenCV 的双线性缩放一致，缩成 1 像素时不需要特例，也就不需要比较、选择两个原始元件；减法由加法和乘以 −1 接出，不作原始元件；透镜接在针孔后面，不另成并行系列；取像素、取通道、合成通道不各占一关演示，跟着第一次需要它们的知识点进来；第 0 章由 15 关并成 9 关。
scope.en: This blueprint covers chapters 0 and 1 (lectures 1–2 and workshop 2): vision tasks and what evidence one image gives; image formation (pinhole projection, lens and depth of field, field of view, converting millimetres and pixels); how a digital image is represented (array, coordinates, channel order, value range); the sampling grid, nearest-neighbour and bilinear resizing, quantisation, cropping and aspect ratio. Against the chapter specification (chapters-0-1.md): translation moves to the filtering chapter, since in chapter 1 only a contrived level used it; resizing uses pixel-centre alignment, as OpenCV's bilinear resize does, which needs no special case for a 1-pixel output and so no compare and select primitives; subtraction is wired from addition and multiplying by −1, not a primitive; the lens follows the pinhole instead of forming a parallel series; lookup, channel and compose get no showcase levels of their own but come in with the first point that needs them; chapter 0 shrinks from 15 levels to 9.

where.zh: 第 0 章的全部关和第 1 章的几个判断任务：vision 的选择判定（choice 任务，判定 fields、claims、cover、refute、pair、same、project）
where.en: All of chapter 0 and a few judgement tasks of chapter 1: the vision domain's choice tasks (judges fields, claims, cover, refute, pair, same, project)

why.zh: 这里要练的是判断：一份输出够不够回答请求、一句论断在所有与图相容的场景里真假、一个样例能不能推翻对分类器的论断、一组测试覆盖了哪些变化。对错由领域按数据算出，答错时画出两个意见相反的场景。机制目录里的「选择判定」没有自己的 id，记在最接近的「纠错」下：玩家检验的是别人的输出和论断。
why.en: What is practised here is judgement: whether an output answers a request, whether a claim holds in every scene compatible with the image, whether a case refutes a claim about a classifier, which changes a test set covers. The domain computes right and wrong from the data and, on a wrong answer, draws two scenes that disagree. The catalogue's choice judgement has no id of its own; it is recorded under the nearest one, audit: the player checks someone else's outputs and claims.

where.zh: 读图填格（grid 任务）：抄数组、点坐标、改像素、填显示值，以及搭采样网格之前手算采样位置
where.en: Reading and filling pixel grids (grid tasks): copying an array, picking coordinates, editing pixels, filling displayed values, and working out sample positions by hand before the sampling grid is built

why.zh: 像素网格和坐标约定本身就是要学的东西；玩家先亲手当一回机器，读写像素、算出新像素落在原图的哪里，电路才有前因。
why.en: The pixel grid and its coordinate conventions are themselves what is learned; the player acts as the machine first, reading and writing pixels and working out where new pixels fall, so that the circuit that follows has a cause.

where.zh: 针孔相机、视场与像素换算（pinhole 模型），透镜、对焦与景深（lens 模型）
where.en: The pinhole camera, field of view and pixel units (the pinhole model); the lens, focus and depth of field (the lens model)

why.zh: 投影、模糊圈和进光量是连续量，拼不出电路：玩家转旋钮，看像的位置、大小和清晰范围怎样变。每一步要么开两个互相牵制的旋钮（亮度和景深），要么场景和相机只能动其一，逼玩家先想再试。
why.en: Projection, blur circles and light are continuous quantities that no circuit wires: the player turns knobs and watches where the image lands, how big it is and what is sharp. Each step either opens two knobs that pull against each other (light against depth of field) or lets only the scene or only the camera move, so the player thinks before trying.

where.zh: 第 1 章的换通道、采样网格、最近邻和双线性缩放、量化、裁剪、宽高比（vision 的 circuit 任务）
where.en: Chapter 1's channel reordering, sampling grid, nearest-neighbour and bilinear resizing, quantisation, cropping and aspect ratio (the vision domain's circuit tasks)

why.zh: 输入定了结果就定了：一张图经坐标网格、取像素和逐元素算术变成另一张图。玩家搭出的采样网格、两种缩放、量化器和裁剪成为元件，后面的电路站在它们上面，跑的是玩家自己的板。
why.en: The input fixes the result: an image becomes another image through a coordinate grid, lookups and element-wise arithmetic. The sampling grid, the two resizers, the quantiser and the crop the player builds become parts, later circuits stand on them, and they run the player's own boards.

about.zh: 回答判断题：把请求配给输出、给论断定真假、挑出样例（choice 任务）
about.en: Answer judgement questions: route requests to outputs, judge claims, pick cases (choice tasks)

about.zh: 受控的三维小场景：渲出图像，能转视角、调光照、放挡板；场景同时是判定用的事实
about.en: A controlled small 3D scene: renders an image, can turn the view, change the light and place a screen; the scene is also the facts the judges use

about.zh: 读写像素格：看图的数和画面，点格、报坐标、改像素、填格子（grid 任务）
about.en: Read and write pixel grids: see an image's numbers and picture, pick cells, report coordinates, edit pixels, fill grids (grid tasks)

about.zh: 相机台：针孔相机和薄透镜的参数台
about.en: The camera bench: parameter benches for the pinhole camera and the thin lens

about.zh: 图像电路：把图和数接成一块板，搭出的板成为元件
about.en: Image circuits: wire images and numbers into a board; a board built becomes a part

lacks.zh: 它只能看场景、看图、判断候选答案：没有相机模型，说不出图里的数从哪里来，也读不了、改不了、算不了一个像素。
lacks.en: It can only look at scenes and images and judge candidate answers: it has no camera model, cannot say where an image's numbers come from, and cannot read, change or compute a single pixel.

lacks.zh: 每个输出像素只由原图里个别位置的值算出：它不能把一个邻域的像素合起来（平滑、找边），也不会学习，这是下一章存在的理由。
lacks.en: Every output pixel is computed from source values at single positions: it cannot combine a neighbourhood of pixels (smoothing, finding edges) and cannot learn — the reason the next chapter exists.

about.zh: 检测回答「哪些物体在哪里」：每个物体给出一个类别和一个边界框。分类只给整张图一个或几个类别标签，不说位置；分割再把答案细化到每个像素。
about.en: Detection answers which objects are where: a class and a bounding box for each object. Classification gives only one or a few class labels for the whole image and says nothing about position; segmentation refines the answer down to each pixel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §1 (vision tasks, slide 7)

wall.zh: 图里有两只猫，问它们在哪里：一个「猫」标签答得上吗？
wall.en: There are two cats in the picture and the question is where they are: does the label 'cat' answer it?

misconception.zh: 类别标签也说出了物体在哪里；或者，一个不带类别的框就是检测结果。
misconception.en: A class label also says where the object is; or a box without a class is a detection.

about.zh: 实例分割给每个像素标出它属于哪一个具体物体（人-1、人-2）；语义分割只标出每个像素属于哪一类，同一类的几个物体挨在一起时连成一片，分不出个数。
about.en: Instance segmentation labels each pixel with the particular object it belongs to (person-1, person-2); semantic segmentation labels only each pixel's class, so touching objects of one class merge into one region and cannot be counted.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §1 (vision tasks, slide 7) and §3 (beyond classification, slide 30)

wall.zh: 两只狗挨在一起：从语义分割图里数得出几只狗吗？
wall.en: Two dogs are touching: can you count the dogs from the semantic segmentation map?

misconception.zh: 同一类的像素属于同一个物体：一片颜色就是一个物体。
misconception.en: Pixels of one class belong to one object: one coloured region is one object.

about.zh: 同一类、甚至同一个物体的照片，会因大小和距离、视角和姿态、光照、背景、遮挡而大不相同：几乎每个像素都变了，物体却没有变。识别因此不能记住像素，要找对这些无关变化有容忍度的表示。
about.en: Photos of one class, even of one object, differ greatly with size and distance, viewpoint and pose, lighting, background and occlusion: nearly every pixel changes while the object does not. Recognition therefore cannot memorise pixels; it needs a representation tolerant of these irrelevant changes.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §3 (why recognition is hard, slide 28)

wall.zh: 两张图几乎没有一个像素相同：拍的会是同一个物体吗？
wall.en: Two images share almost no pixel values: can they show the same object?

misconception.zh: 像素变了，物体就变了。
misconception.en: If the pixels changed, the object changed.

about.zh: 视觉系统鲁棒，是说输入有无关的变化（视角、光照、背景，甚至只改几个像素的对抗样本）时，输出仍然可靠。一次答对、哪怕置信度很高，也证明不了它；一个反例就能推翻「总能认出」，所以测试集要把每一种变化都覆盖到。
about.en: A vision system is robust when irrelevant changes to its input (viewpoint, lighting, background, even the few altered pixels of an adversarial example) leave its output reliable. One correct answer, however confident, does not show it; one counterexample refutes 'it always recognises', so a test set must cover each kind of change.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 (adversarial examples, slides 2–3)

wall.zh: 分类器认对了这张猫的照片，置信度 99%：它换了背景也认得出猫吗？
wall.en: The classifier labelled this cat photo correctly with 99% confidence: will it still recognise the cat against another background?

misconception.zh: 一次答对，置信度又高，就说明模型可靠。
misconception.en: One correct, confident prediction shows the model is reliable.

about.zh: 图形学由物体、材质、光照和相机正向生成图像，是正问题；视觉反过来从图像推回这些东西，是反问题。三维场景投成二维图像丢了一维信息，不同的场景能生成同一张图，所以单凭一张图，有些问题没有唯一的答案。
about.en: Graphics generates an image forwards from objects, materials, lighting and camera: a forward problem. Vision infers them backwards from the image: an inverse problem. Projecting a 3D scene to a 2D image loses a dimension and different scenes can produce the same image, so from one image alone some questions have no unique answer.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §2 (vision and graphics, slide 8)

wall.zh: 只看这一张图，红色箱子离相机多远？
wall.en: From this image alone, how far is the red box from the camera?

misconception.zh: 一张图唯一地决定了它拍下的场景。
misconception.en: An image determines the scene it shows.

about.zh: 相机把光变成电信号，计算机存下的是数：灰度图是 高 × 宽 的二维数组，每格是一个像素的亮度；彩色图多一维通道，是 高 × 宽 × 3 的张量，每个像素是 (R, G, B) 三个数。数组的形状先写高、再写宽。一个像素只说这里有多亮，不说这一点离相机多远。
about.en: The camera turns light into a signal and the computer stores numbers: a greyscale image is a height × width array, each cell one pixel's brightness; a colour image adds a channel axis, a height × width × 3 tensor, each pixel three numbers (R, G, B). The shape lists height first, then width. A pixel says how bright a place is, not how far it is from the camera.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 (image tensor, slide 22) and §1 (image formation, slide 8)

wall.zh: 这张 3 像素宽、2 像素高的小图，存进计算机是什么样子？
wall.en: What does this picture, 3 pixels wide and 2 high, look like once it is stored in the computer?

misconception.zh: 数组按「宽 × 高」排，一行是图里的一列；彩色像素只存一个数。
misconception.en: The array is stored width × height, a row being a column of the picture; and a colour pixel is one number.

about.zh: 图像坐标从左上角起、从 0 数：x 向右增大，y 向下增大，和数学课上 y 轴朝上的坐标不同。按数组读时先行后列，写成 I[y, x]；OpenCV 的尺寸却写成 (宽, 高)。
about.en: Image coordinates start at the top-left corner and count from 0: x grows to the right and y grows downwards, unlike the upward y of school geometry. Read as an array, row comes first: I[y, x]; OpenCV, though, writes a size as (width, height).

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 (pixel coordinates, slide 26)

wall.zh: 坐标 (0, 1) 是哪一个像素？
wall.en: Which pixel is at coordinates (0, 1)?

misconception.zh: y 轴朝上；或者 (x, y) 就是数组的第 x 行、第 y 列。
misconception.en: y points up; or (x, y) is row x, column y of the array.

about.zh: 针孔相机把三维点 (X, Y, Z) 投到离针孔 f 的像平面上：x = fX/Z，y = fY/Z（相似三角形）。同样大的物体越远（Z 越大）像越小，焦距 f 越长像越大。讲义把像平面画在针孔前面，像不倒过来，这是坐标约定，不是真的传感器位置。
about.en: A pinhole camera projects a 3D point (X, Y, Z) onto the image plane at distance f from the hole: x = fX/Z, y = fY/Z (similar triangles). An object of a given size images smaller the farther it is (larger Z) and larger the longer the focal length f. The lectures draw the image plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright: a coordinate convention, not where the sensor really is.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 (pinhole camera model, slide 11) and §2 (image formation model, slide 18)

wall.zh: 物体退到两倍远，它的像落在像平面的哪里、有多高？
wall.en: When the object moves twice as far away, where does its image land on the image plane and how tall is it?

misconception.zh: 像的位置和大小只由物体决定，和距离无关（u = X）。
misconception.en: Where an image lands and how big it is depend only on the object, not on its distance (u = X).

about.zh: 针孔小，进光少，图暗；把孔开大，同一点的光落到传感器上的不同地方，图就糊。透镜让大孔进来的光重新会聚到一点，但只对对焦距离上的点会聚得准，别的距离的点在传感器上成一个模糊圈。光圈直径 D 管进光量，焦距 f 管像的大小，两者不能混。
about.en: A small pinhole lets in little light and the image is dark; widen the hole and light from one point lands at different places on the sensor, and the image blurs. A lens brings the light through a wide opening back to a point, but only for points at the focus distance; points at other depths make a blur circle on the sensor. The aperture diameter D sets the light, the focal length f the image size; the two are not to be confused.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 (why cameras need lenses, slides 12–13)

wall.zh: 要让图更亮又不变糊，把小孔开大够吗？
wall.en: To make the image brighter without blurring it, is widening the pinhole enough?

misconception.zh: 孔开大了只会更亮，不会更糊；对好焦以后每个距离都清晰。
misconception.en: A wider opening only brightens the image and does not blur it; once focused, every depth is sharp.

about.zh: 景深是同时显得清晰的深度范围。光圈小，模糊圈小，景深大，但进光少；光圈大，进光多，景深窄。摄影上用 f 数 = 焦距 / 光圈直径表示光圈：70 mm 镜头在 f/5.6 时光圈直径约 12.5 mm，f/32 的光圈更小、景深更大。
about.en: Depth of field is the range of depths that look sharp at once. A small aperture makes small blur circles and a deep range but lets in little light; a large aperture lets in more light and the range narrows. Photography states the aperture as the f-number = focal length / aperture diameter: a 70 mm lens at f/5.6 has an aperture of about 12.5 mm, and f/32 is a smaller aperture with a deeper sharp range.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 (aperture and depth of field, slide 16)

wall.zh: 近处和远处两个物体，怎样在一张照片里都清晰？
wall.en: How can a near and a far object both be sharp in one photo?

misconception.zh: 光圈只管亮度，和清晰的深度范围无关。
misconception.en: The aperture only sets brightness and has nothing to do with how deep the sharp range is.

about.zh: 传感器大小一定时，焦距决定看得多宽：焦距短，视场大，看得宽；焦距长，视场小，物体在图里显得大。图像宽 2000 像素、主点居中、焦距 1000 像素时，每边约 45°，视场约 90°。
about.en: With the sensor size fixed, the focal length decides how wide the camera sees: a short focal length gives a wide field of view; a long one a narrow view in which objects look larger. For an image 2000 pixels wide with the principal point in the middle and a focal length of 1000 pixels, each side covers about 45° and the field of view is about 90°.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 (focal length and field of view, slide 15)

wall.zh: 要把一排物体全拍进画面，焦距该变长还是变短？
wall.en: To get a whole row of objects into the frame, should the focal length grow or shrink?

misconception.zh: 焦距越长，画面装下的东西越多。
misconception.en: The longer the focal length, the more of the scene the frame holds.

about.zh: 像平面上的长度以毫米计，图像里的长度以像素计，两者靠传感器的尺寸换算（每个像素多少毫米）。以像素计的焦距就是物理焦距除以像素尺寸。物体在 20 mm、200 像素高的传感器上占 100 像素，就是 10 mm；先换成毫米，再代入 h/f = H/Z。
about.en: Lengths on the image plane are in millimetres and lengths in the image in pixels; the sensor's size converts one to the other (millimetres per pixel). The focal length in pixels is the physical focal length divided by the pixel size. An object covering 100 pixels of a sensor 20 mm and 200 pixels tall is 10 mm tall on it; convert to millimetres first, then use h/f = H/Z.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (workshop 2: finding the focal length from the sensor size) and §2 (focal length in pixels)

wall.zh: 物体在图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm、离相机 600 mm：镜头焦距是多少毫米？
wall.en: An object is 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall in reality and 600 mm from the camera: what is the lens's focal length in millimetres?

misconception.zh: 把像素数当成毫米，直接代进相似三角形的比例。
misconception.en: Put the pixel count straight into the similar-triangles ratio as if it were millimetres.

about.zh: 彩色图三个通道怎么排没有统一约定：OpenCV 读图得到 BGR，Matplotlib 按 RGB 显示。顺序弄错，红和蓝对调，形状和尺寸都不变；换顺序只是重排通道，不改图像的内容和大小。
about.en: There is no single convention for ordering a colour image's three channels: OpenCV reads images as BGR, Matplotlib displays them as RGB. Get the order wrong and red and blue swap while the shape and size stay; reordering only rearranges the channels and changes neither the content nor the size.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 (channel ordering, slide 25) and §4 (workshop 2: colour order in OpenCV and Matplotlib)

wall.zh: 用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，天空显示成了橙色：哪里错了？
wall.en: A photo read with OpenCV shows an orange sky: what went wrong?

misconception.zh: 每个库都按 RGB 存通道。
misconception.en: Every library stores the channels as RGB.

about.zh: 像素值有范围和类型：uint8 是 0 到 255 的整数，白是 255；处理时常换成 [0, 1] 的浮点数，好做加减乘除、不溢出。计算结果可以超出范围，显示时才把超出的值截到两端，存着的数不变：看上去一样白的两个像素，存的数可以不同。
about.en: Pixel values have a range and a type: uint8 holds whole numbers from 0 to 255, white being 255; processing often converts to floats in [0, 1] so that arithmetic works without overflow. Results may leave the range; only the display clips them to its ends, and the stored numbers stay: two pixels that look equally white can hold different values.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 (pixel coordinates, data types and file formats, slide 26); docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/chapters-0-1.md §1F1

wall.zh: 两个像素看上去一样白：存着的数一样吗？
wall.en: Two pixels look equally white: do they hold the same value?

misconception.zh: 屏幕上看到的就是存着的数，显示的截断改掉了数据。
misconception.en: What the screen shows is what is stored; clipping for display changes the data.

about.zh: 缩放一张图，要给新图的每个像素算出值，先得知道它在原图里的位置：在新图上铺一张采样网格，把每个新像素反向映射回原图的坐标，而不是把旧像素正向搬过去（那样放大时会留下空洞）。本课按像素中心对齐（OpenCV 的双线性缩放、PyTorch 的 align_corners=False 也这样）：宽从 m 变成 n 时，新像素 x 对应原图的 (x + 0.5)·m/n − 0.5，这个位置一般落在两个旧像素之间。库与库的约定不同，所以要写明。
about.en: To resize an image every new pixel needs a value, and first a position in the original: lay a sampling grid over the new image and map each new pixel back to coordinates in the original, rather than pushing old pixels forwards (which leaves holes when enlarging). This course aligns pixel centres, as OpenCV's bilinear resize and PyTorch's align_corners=False do: when a width m becomes n, new pixel x sits at (x + 0.5)·m/n − 0.5 in the original, which usually falls between two old pixels. Libraries differ in this convention, so it must be stated.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (cropping and resizing, slide 34); docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/chapters-0-1.md §1E (resizing convention)

wall.zh: 2 像素宽的一行放大成 3 像素，新的中间那一格在原图的什么位置？
wall.en: A row 2 pixels wide is enlarged to 3: where in the original does the new middle pixel sit?

misconception.zh: 新图第 i 个像素就是原图第 i 个像素；或者把旧像素正向搬到新图上。
misconception.en: New pixel i is old pixel i; or old pixels are pushed forwards onto the new image.

about.zh: 每个新像素复制原图里离它最近的那个像素的值。快，边缘硬，但放大后成块，缩小时整列整行的像素被丢掉。离两边一样远时按约定取坐标较大的一边。OpenCV 里叫 INTER_NEAREST。
about.en: Each new pixel copies the value of the original pixel nearest to it. It is fast and keeps edges hard, but enlarging makes blocks and shrinking drops whole rows and columns. When a position is equally far from two pixels, the convention takes the larger coordinate. OpenCV calls it INTER_NEAREST.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (nearest-neighbour interpolation, slide 35)

wall.zh: 放大时新像素落在两个旧像素之间，它的值从哪里来？
wall.en: When an image is enlarged and a new pixel falls between two old ones, where does its value come from?

misconception.zh: 新位置一律向下取整，再去读原图。
misconception.en: Always round the new position down and read the original there.

about.zh: 新位置落在两个相邻像素之间、离左边那个的距离是 t（0 ≤ t < 1）时，值取两边按距离的加权平均：(1 − t)·I[x0] + t·I[x0 + 1]。权重之和为 1，离得越近权重越大，所以新值介于两边之间。
about.en: When a new position lies between two neighbouring pixels at distance t from the left one (0 ≤ t < 1), its value is their distance-weighted average: (1 − t)·I[x0] + t·I[x0 + 1]. The weights sum to 1 and the nearer pixel weighs more, so the new value lies between the two.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (bilinear interpolation, slide 36: the one-dimensional case)

wall.zh: [0, 1] 放大成 3 格，中间那格只能是 0 或 1 吗？
wall.en: When [0, 1] is enlarged to 3 pixels, must the middle one be 0 or 1?

misconception.zh: 新像素只能照抄某一个旧像素。
misconception.en: A new pixel can only copy one of the old pixels.

about.zh: 在二维里，新位置落在四个旧像素之间；横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V 时，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV，和为 1：新值是四个邻居的加权平均，等于先沿 x、再沿 y 各做一次线性插值。它比最近邻平滑，却会把很锐的边变软。OpenCV 里叫 INTER_LINEAR；双三次（bicubic）和 Lanczos 看更大的邻域，没有一种插值对每个任务都最好。
about.en: In two dimensions a new position falls between four old pixels; with horizontal distance H and vertical distance V the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV, summing to 1: the new value is a weighted average of the four neighbours, the same as linear interpolation along x and then along y. It is smoother than nearest neighbour but softens very sharp edges. OpenCV calls it INTER_LINEAR; bicubic and Lanczos look at larger neighbourhoods, and no interpolation is best for every task.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (bilinear weights, slide 36; resampling trade-offs, slide 37)

wall.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素中间，它的值怎么算？
wall.en: A new pixel falls among four old ones: how is its value computed?

misconception.zh: 只沿一个方向插值就够了，另一个方向照抄最近的一行。
misconception.en: Interpolating along one axis is enough; along the other, copy the nearest row.

about.zh: 传感器的信号最后存成有限个取值：uint8 每个值是 0 到 255 的整数，共 256 级。把实数存成 L 级，先把它截到可表示的范围，再取最近的一级（四舍五入，不是截掉小数）。不同的值会落到同一级，量化丢掉的信息找不回来。
about.en: The sensor's signal ends up stored as finitely many values: in uint8 each value is a whole number from 0 to 255, 256 levels. Storing a real number in L levels first clips it to the representable range and then takes the nearest level (rounding, not cutting off the fraction). Different values fall into the same level, and what quantisation discards cannot be recovered.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 (data types, uint8 range, explicit casts) and §1 (sensor to digital values); docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/chapters-0-1.md §1F2

wall.zh: 一个 [0, 1] 里的值只能存成 3 级（0、0.5、1）中的一级：0.8 该存成哪一级？
wall.en: A value in [0, 1] can only be stored as one of 3 levels (0, 0.5, 1): which level should 0.8 become?

misconception.zh: 乘上级数后截掉小数就是存成整数级，存下的值和原值一样。
misconception.en: Multiplying by the number of levels and cutting off the fraction stores the value, and the stored value equals the original.

about.zh: 裁剪取原数组的一个子区域，已有的像素值原样保留，不算新值；缩放改变数组的大小，要给新位置算出值。NumPy 里写成 image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]。中心裁剪的起点是 x0 = ⌊(W − w)/2⌋、y0 = ⌊(H − h)/2⌋。
about.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array and keeps its pixel values as they are, computing nothing new; resizing changes the array's size and must compute values for the new positions. In NumPy it is image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]. A centre crop starts at x0 = ⌊(W − w)/2⌋, y0 = ⌊(H − h)/2⌋.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (cropping and resizing are not the same thing, slide 34; workshop 2: centre cropping)

wall.zh: 从图里取出一块 2×2：输出的四个值是原图里已有的，还是新算的？
wall.en: When a 2×2 block is taken out of an image, are its four values ones the original holds, or newly computed?

misconception.zh: 裁剪就是把整张图缩小到要的尺寸。
misconception.en: Cropping means shrinking the whole image to the requested size.

about.zh: 宽高比是图的宽与高之比。把 768×512 直接压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体变胖或变瘦；要保持比例，宽和高乘同一个比例（约 512×341），要的形状再用裁剪取出。OpenCV 的尺寸写成 (宽, 高)，NumPy 的形状是 (高, 宽, 通道)，不能照搬。
about.en: The aspect ratio is an image's width over its height. Squashing 768×512 straight into 512×512 changes it, and objects grow fatter or thinner; to keep proportions, scale width and height by one factor (about 512×341) and take the wanted shape with a crop. OpenCV writes a size as (width, height) while a NumPy shape is (height, width, channels); one cannot be passed as the other.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 (cropping and resizing, slide 34; workshop 2: resizing and centre cropping)

wall.zh: 网络要 512×512 的输入，手里是 768×512 的照片：直接缩放到 512×512 可以吗？
wall.en: A network wants 512×512 input and the photo is 768×512: can it simply be resized to 512×512?

misconception.zh: 缩放到要的尺寸就行，宽和高各缩各的。
misconception.en: Resizing to the wanted size is enough, width and height each scaled on its own.

about.zh: 给出彩色图的第 c 个通道，是一张灰度图
about.en: Gives channel c of a colour image as a grey image

why.zh: 逐元素的算术只把一个像素当一个整体处理，拆不开它的三个数。
why.en: Element-wise arithmetic treats a pixel as one whole and cannot take its three numbers apart.

about.zh: 把三张同样大小的灰度图合成一张彩色图
about.en: Makes three grey images of one size into one colour image

why.zh: 没有别的元件能从灰度图造出一张三通道的图。
why.en: No other part can make a three-channel image out of grey ones.

about.zh: 始终给出设定的数
about.en: Always gives the number it is set to

why.zh: 其余元件只变换它们的输入，造不出一个固定的数（0.5、−1、像素中心的偏移）。
why.en: Every other part only transforms its inputs and cannot produce a fixed number (0.5, −1, the pixel-centre offset).

about.zh: 给定宽和高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 坐标的两张坐标图
about.en: Given a width and a height, gives the two coordinate images whose cells hold their own x and y

why.zh: 新图的每个像素要先有自己的坐标；没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图。
why.en: Every pixel of the new image first needs its own coordinates, and no part makes a whole image from two numbers.

about.zh: 逐元素给出两者之和
about.en: Gives the element-wise sum of the two

why.zh: 基本算术；这门课学的是图像，不是从更低的元件搭出加法（手册第 8 节：原始元件选得太低）。减法由它和乘以 −1 接出，所以不另设。
why.en: Basic arithmetic: the course is about images, not about building addition from lower parts (handbook §8, primitives too low). Subtraction is wired from it and multiplying by −1, so it is not a primitive.

about.zh: 逐元素给出两者之积
about.en: Gives the element-wise product of the two

why.zh: 按比例缩放坐标、按距离加权都要乘法；加法接不出两个变量的乘积。
why.en: Scaling coordinates and weighting by distance need multiplication; addition cannot wire the product of two variables.

about.zh: 逐元素给出 a 除以 b，除以 0 时报错
about.en: Gives a divided by b element-wise, stopping on division by 0

why.zh: 原尺寸和新尺寸之比 m/n 由输入决定，加法和乘法接不出倒数。
why.en: The ratio m/n of the two sizes comes from the inputs, and addition and multiplication cannot wire a reciprocal.

about.zh: 给出一张图的宽 w 和高 h
about.en: Gives an image's width w and height h

why.zh: 图的宽和高不在任何一个像素值里。
why.en: An image's width and height are in none of its pixel values.

about.zh: 逐元素给出不大于它的最大整数
about.en: Gives the largest whole number not above it, element-wise

why.zh: 加减乘除都是连续的，接不出把连续的坐标变成整数下标的一步。
why.en: The four arithmetic operations are continuous and cannot wire the step that turns a continuous coordinate into a whole index.

about.zh: 按坐标（数或坐标图）在图上取值，出界时按设置报错、取 0 或取最近的边
about.en: Reads an image at coordinates (numbers or coordinate images); outside the image it stops, reads 0 or reads the nearest edge, as set

why.zh: 逐元素的元件只在同一个位置上算，只有它能把一处的值搬到另一处。
why.en: Element-wise parts compute in place; only this part moves a value from one position to another.

about.zh: 逐元素给出两者中小的那个
about.en: Gives the smaller of the two, element-wise

why.zh: 加减乘除和向下取整都定不出一个值的上界。
why.en: Arithmetic and floor cannot put an upper bound on a value.

about.zh: 逐元素给出两者中大的那个
about.en: Gives the larger of the two, element-wise

why.zh: 截断到区间的另一端。它能由取小和两次取负接出（−min(−a, −b)），但那是和视觉无关的符号技巧（手册第 8 节）：取小和取大是截断这一个概念的两半，一起进来。
why.en: The other end of clipping to a range. It can be wired from min and two negations (−min(−a, −b)), but that is a sign trick unrelated to vision (handbook §8): min and max are the two halves of the one idea of clipping and come in together.

about.zh: 采样网格：给定原图的宽高和新图的宽高，给出新图每个像素在原图里的坐标（两张源坐标图）
about.en: Sampling grid: given the original's width and height and the new ones, gives each new pixel's coordinates in the original (two source-coordinate images)

about.zh: 最近邻缩放：输入一张图和新的宽、高
about.en: Nearest-neighbour resize: an image and the new width and height

about.zh: 线性缩放：先只沿一行插值，再升级成双线性；输入一张图和新的宽、高
about.en: Linear resize: first interpolating along rows only, then upgraded to bilinear; an image and the new width and height

about.zh: 量化器：输入一张图和级数 L，截到 [0, 1] 后存成最近的一级
about.en: Quantiser: an image and a number of levels L; clips to [0, 1] and stores the nearest level

about.zh: 裁剪：输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h
about.en: Crop: an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and the width w and height h

why.zh: 「外观会变」和「一张图能说明什么」都只站在第一个系列上（判断一份答案要先知道问题要什么输出），彼此不用对方的任何东西；「让检查台上岗」三样都要，在它们之后汇合。
why.en: 'Appearance changes' and 'What an image can tell' stand only on the first series (judging an answer needs knowing what output the question asks for) and use nothing of each other; 'Put the station to work' needs all three and joins after them.

why.zh: 相机（光学台）、读对一张图（通道顺序与数值范围）和缩放流水线（电路）都只站在「数字图像」系列上：相机一路到最后才用像素坐标换算焦距，流水线自己带来全部算术元件，通道一路只要取通道、合成彩色。三路互不依赖，章在三路都走完时结束。
why.en: The camera (optics benches), reading an image right (channel order and value range) and the resizing pipeline (circuits) stand only on the 'digital image' series: the camera branch uses pixel coordinates only at its end, to convert the focal length; the pipeline brings all its own arithmetic; the colour branch needs only channel and compose. The three are independent, and the chapter ends when all three are done.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

why.zh: 从最窄的机器起步：检查台只会看场景、看图、判断候选答案，什么都不算。先弄清一张图上能提出哪些问题、各要什么样的输出、图里的证据有多少，后面搭的流水线才知道要交出什么。
why.en: It starts with the narrowest machine: the station only looks at scenes and images and judges candidate answers, computing nothing. First learn which questions an image can be asked, what output each needs and how much evidence an image holds, so the pipelines built later know what they must deliver.

task.zh: 为每个问题选出能回答它的输出：类别标签、带类别的框、不带类别的框或逐像素的类别图。
task.en: For each question, choose the outputs that answer it: a class label, labelled boxes, bare boxes or a per-pixel class map.

question.zh: 图里有哪些物体、它们在哪里：一个答案至少要带上哪些信息？
question.en: Which objects are in the image and where are they: what must an answer contain at the least?

chain.zh: 第一轮问「图里有猫吗」和「猫在哪里」：玩家给第二问也选了「猫」这个标签，判定指出它缺了位置。
chain.en: Round one asks 'is there a cat?' and 'where are the cats?': the player gives the second question the label 'cat' as well, and the verdict says it lacks a position.

chain.zh: 换成两个带类别的框后通过；玩家看出「在哪里」要每个物体各有一个位置。
chain.en: Two labelled boxes pass; the player sees that 'where' asks for a position for each object.

chain.zh: 第二轮的候选里有不带类别的框：它说了在哪里，没说是什么，判定指出缺了类别。
chain.en: Round two offers boxes without classes: they say where but not what, and the verdict names the missing class.

naive.zh: 把类别标签当成检测结果：标签只说有什么，不说在哪里，「在哪里」那一问判错。
naive.en: Take the class label as the detection: it says what but not where, and the 'where' question fails.

task.zh: 为每个问题选出能回答它的分割图：语义分割图或实例分割图。
task.en: For each question, choose the segmentation map that answers it: a semantic map or an instance map.

question.zh: 「每个像素属于哪一类」和「每个像素属于哪一个物体」是同一个问题吗？
question.en: Is 'which class does each pixel belong to' the same question as 'which object does each pixel belong to'?

chain.zh: 问「有几只狗、每只占哪些像素」：玩家选了语义分割图，两只狗连成一片，判定指出从它只数得出一片。
chain.en: The question is 'how many dogs, and which pixels belong to each': the player picks the semantic map, the two dogs form one region, and the verdict says it shows only one region.

chain.zh: 实例分割图给两只狗不同的编号，通过；玩家看出语义图答「哪一类」，实例图答「哪一个」。
chain.en: The instance map gives the two dogs different ids and passes; the player sees that the semantic map answers 'which class', the instance map 'which one'.

chain.zh: 第二轮一只狗被柱子挡成两块：实例图把两块标成同一个编号，玩家看出数的是物体，不是色块。
chain.en: In round two a post cuts one dog into two pieces: the instance map gives both pieces one id, and the player sees that it counts objects, not coloured patches.

naive.zh: 把同一类的像素都算作一个物体：挨着的两只狗只数出一只。
naive.en: Count all pixels of one class as one object: the two touching dogs count as one.

task.zh: 把几个请求配给能回答它们的输出：类别标签、检测框、语义图、实例图、深度图；一个请求可以有几个够用的输出。
task.en: Route several requests to the outputs that answer them: a class label, detection boxes, a semantic map, an instance map, a depth map; a request may have several sufficient outputs.

question.zh: 「那辆车离我多远」该由哪种输出回答？类别图里的数能当距离用吗？
question.en: Which output answers 'how far away is that car'? Can the numbers in a class map serve as distances?

chain.zh: 玩家给「路面在哪些像素」配上语义图，给「每个人各在哪」配上实例图和检测框，都通过。
chain.en: The player routes 'which pixels are road' to the semantic map and 'where is each person' to the instance map and the boxes; both pass.

chain.zh: 给「这个像素处的车多远」配了语义图，判定指出它的值是类别编号，不是距离。
chain.en: Routing 'how far is the car at this pixel' to the semantic map fails: its values are class ids, not distances.

chain.zh: 改配深度图，它的值以米计；玩家看出一份输出的值是什么意思、以什么为单位，决定了它能回答什么。
chain.en: The depth map, in metres, passes; the player sees that what an output's values mean, and in what unit, decides what it can answer.

facet.zh: 输出的值是什么意思、以什么为单位：深度图回答距离，任何类别输出都回答不了（三维恢复的输出）
facet.en: What an output's values mean and their unit: a depth map answers distance, which no class output can (the output of 3D reconstruction)

task.zh: 转动场景里的相机、调整光照，判断每张候选图是不是同一个物体拍出来的。
task.en: Turn the scene's camera and change its light, and decide whether each candidate image shows the same object.

question.zh: 两张图的像素几乎都不同，拍的会是同一个物体吗？
question.en: Two images differ in almost every pixel: can they show the same object?

chain.zh: 参照图是一个不对称的物体，候选图和它几乎没有一个像素相同；玩家凭像素判「不是同一个」，判错。
chain.en: The reference is an asymmetric object and a candidate shares almost no pixel with it; judging by pixels, the player says 'not the same' and is wrong.

chain.zh: 玩家转动相机，转到某个方位时场景渲出的图和候选图一样：只是换了视角。
chain.en: The player turns the camera, and at one angle the scene renders exactly the candidate: only the viewpoint changed.

chain.zh: 第二个任务只动光照：光从左移到右，明暗和阴影全变了；另一张候选图里物体本身变了形，怎么转、怎么照都对不上。
chain.en: The second task moves only the light: from left to right, shading and shadows all change; another candidate shows a reshaped object that no turn or light can match.

naive.zh: 按像素是否相同判断是不是同一个物体：换了视角或光照的图被判成别的物体。
naive.en: Judge sameness by equal pixels: an image with another viewpoint or light is taken for another object.

task.zh: 对照几组带标签的样例和分类器的预测，选出能推翻「它在任何背景下都认得出」的样例；没有就选「没有」。
task.en: Compare labelled cases with a classifier's predictions and pick the case that refutes 'it recognises the object against any background', or 'none' if there is none.

question.zh: 分类器在一张照片上答对了，而且很有把握：这能说明它换了背景也认得出吗？
question.en: A classifier got one photo right, and confidently: does that show it will recognise the object against other backgrounds?

chain.zh: 玩家选了置信度最高、答对了的那张当证据，判定指出答对的样例推翻不了这句论断。
chain.en: The player picks the most confident correct case as evidence; the verdict says a correct case cannot refute the claim.

chain.zh: 玩家逐个对照预测和标签，找到同一个物体换了背景就被认错的那张，选它通过。
chain.en: Checking each prediction against its label, the player finds the same object misread against a new background, and picking it passes.

chain.zh: 下一轮换了数据，每个预测都和标签一致，正确答案是「没有」：玩家看出没找到反例不等于论断成立。
chain.en: The next round's predictions all match their labels and the answer is 'none': the player sees that finding no counterexample does not make the claim true.

naive.zh: 拿一张答对、置信度高的样例当作「总能认出」的证明。
naive.en: Take one correct, confident case as proof that it always recognises.

task.zh: 从一批样例里选出一组测试，让它覆盖换视角、换光照和有遮挡三种变化。
task.en: From a batch of cases, choose a test set that covers a changed viewpoint, changed lighting and occlusion.

question.zh: 要检验分类器对无关变化是否鲁棒，测试集里该放哪些样例？
question.en: To test whether a classifier is robust to irrelevant change, which cases belong in the test set?

chain.zh: 玩家先选了几张几乎一样的正面照，判定指出视角、光照、遮挡一样也没覆盖到。
chain.en: The player first picks several near-identical front views; the verdict says none of viewpoint, lighting or occlusion is covered.

chain.zh: 玩家看出每张样例变的是什么，补上换视角、换光照、有遮挡的样例；有一张同时覆盖两种变化。
chain.en: The player reads what changes in each case and adds a changed view, a changed light and an occlusion; one case covers two changes at once.

chain.zh: 下一轮打乱了样例、换了覆盖的重叠方式，玩家按每张的变化重新挑选。
chain.en: The next round shuffles the cases and overlaps their coverage differently, and the player chooses again by what each case changes.

facet.zh: 从检验一句论断，反过来设计检验：测试集要让每一种无关变化至少出现一次
facet.en: From judging a claim to designing the test: a test set must contain each irrelevant change at least once

task.zh: 对着一张图和几个都渲得出这张图的候选场景，判断关于场景的每句话成立、不成立还是无法确定。
task.en: Given an image and several candidate scenes that all render it, judge each statement about the scene as holding, not holding or undetermined.

question.zh: 只看这一张图，红色箱子离相机多远？
question.en: From this image alone, how far is the red box from the camera?

chain.zh: 玩家按箱子在图里的大小判「箱子离相机 2 米」成立，判错。
chain.en: Going by the box's size in the image, the player judges 'the box is 2 m away' to hold, and is wrong.

chain.zh: 答错时画面从侧面画出两个候选场景：一个箱子小而近，一个大而远，从相机看去渲出的图一模一样。
chain.en: On the wrong answer the screen draws two candidate scenes from the side: one box small and near, one large and far, rendering the same image from the camera.

chain.zh: 玩家改判「无法确定」，而「箱子是红色的」在每个场景里都成立；他看出图像由场景正向生成，反推回去答案可以不唯一。
chain.en: The player changes it to 'undetermined' while 'the box is red' holds in every scene; images are generated forwards from scenes, and going backwards the answer need not be unique.

naive.zh: 按箱子在图里的大小定出一个唯一的距离。
naive.en: Read one definite distance off the box's size in the image.

task.zh: 一块不透明挡板挡住了场景的一部分：判断关于场景的每句话成立、不成立还是无法确定。
task.en: An opaque screen hides part of the scene: judge each statement about the scene as holding, not holding or undetermined.

question.zh: 图里看不到的东西，图像能说明它是什么吗？
question.en: Can an image say what something it does not show is?

chain.zh: 玩家根据挡板边上露出的一角判「挡板后面是一辆车」成立，判错；反馈从侧面画出两个场景，挡板后面的东西不同。
chain.en: From a corner showing at the screen's edge the player judges 'there is a car behind the screen' to hold and is wrong; the feedback draws two scenes from the side with different things behind it.

chain.zh: 玩家把关于挡板后面的话改成「无法确定」，关于看得见的物体的话照常判断。
chain.en: The player marks the statements about what is behind the screen 'undetermined' and judges the visible objects as before.

chain.zh: 「场景里没有蓝色物体」也只能判无法确定：一个蓝色物体可能整个藏在挡板后面。
chain.en: 'There is no blue object in the scene' is also undetermined: a blue object could hide entirely behind the screen.

facet.zh: 遮挡：整个被挡住的东西，图像既不能证实也不能否定，连「没有」也说不出
facet.en: Occlusion: of something entirely hidden the image can neither confirm nor deny anything, not even that it is absent

title.en: A task for a rescue robot

task.zh: 为救援机器人的请求「找出每个人」选定输出，为每种输出选出能拿来检验它的参照，再判断哪些问题单凭它的一张图答不了。
task.en: Choose the outputs for a rescue robot's request 'find every person', pair each output with a reference that can test it, and judge which questions its one image cannot answer.

question.zh: 救援机器人要找到每个人并靠过去：它的视觉输出要包含什么，又该怎样检验？
question.en: A rescue robot must find every person and go to them: what must its vision output contain, and how should that be tested?

chain.zh: 玩家先选「人」的类别标签，判定指出机器人不知道往哪里走；改成每人一个带类别的框，场景里没有人时是空集。
chain.en: The player first picks the class label 'person'; the verdict says the robot would not know where to go; one labelled box per person passes, and an empty set when no one is there.

chain.zh: 第二个任务把预测配给参照：预测的框配参照框，预测的距离配测出的距离；把距离配给类别标签判错，两边量的不是同一种东西。
chain.en: The second task pairs predictions with references: predicted boxes with reference boxes, predicted distances with measured ones; pairing a distance with a class label fails, since the two sides measure different things.

chain.zh: 第三个任务里，「最近的人离机器人 3 米」在候选场景里有真有假：单凭一张图无法确定。
chain.en: In the third task, 'the nearest person is 3 m from the robot' is true in some candidate scenes and false in others: one image cannot settle it.

facet.zh: 把输出、检验和单张图的局限放进同一个应用：机器人的动作决定输出要包含什么
facet.en: Outputs, tests and the limits of one image in one application: the robot's action decides what the output must contain

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一组数，这组数又怎样被裁剪、缩放和存下来？
question.en: How does a scene become an array of numbers, and how is that array cropped, resized and stored?

why.zh: 检查台能判断答案，却说不出图里的数从哪里来，也碰不了一个像素：它没有相机模型，不会读写像素，也不会计算。这一章给它装上相机台和图像工作台。
why.en: The station could judge answers but could not say where an image's numbers come from or touch a single pixel: it had no camera model, could not read or write pixels and could not compute. This chapter gives it a camera bench and an image workbench.

task.zh: 把一张小图的数照抄进空格子，再把一个彩色像素改成给定的颜色。
task.en: Copy a small image's numbers into an empty grid, then change one colour pixel to a given colour.

question.zh: 相机拍下的这张小图，存进计算机是什么样子？
question.en: What does this small picture from the camera look like once it is stored in the computer?

chain.zh: 画面是一张 3 像素宽、2 像素高的灰度图，旁边是它的数；玩家抄成 3 行 2 列，形状和格子对不上。
chain.en: The picture is a greyscale image 3 pixels wide and 2 high with its numbers beside it; the player copies them into 3 rows of 2 and the shape does not fit the grid.

chain.zh: 下一轮换成 2 像素宽、3 像素高的图，玩家看出数组先写高、再写宽，一行就是图里的一行像素。
chain.en: The next round has an image 2 wide and 3 high, and the player sees that the array lists height first, then width, each row being a row of pixels.

chain.zh: 第二个任务给一张彩色小图：要把一个像素改成蓝色，只改一个数做不到，要写成 (0, 0, 1) 三个数，别的格子不变。
chain.en: The second task gives a small colour image: turning one pixel blue cannot be done by changing one number; it takes the three numbers (0, 0, 1), leaving every other cell unchanged.

naive.zh: 把图按「宽 × 高」抄成数组：形状转置，图里的第一行抄成了第一列。
naive.en: Copy the image as width × height: the shape is transposed and the picture's first row becomes the first column.

task.zh: 在图上点出给定坐标的像素，再写出高亮像素的坐标。
task.en: Pick the pixel at given coordinates on an image, then write the coordinates of a highlighted pixel.

question.zh: 图像坐标 (x, y) 指的是哪一个像素？
question.en: Which pixel do image coordinates (x, y) refer to?

chain.zh: 玩家照数学课的习惯，把 (0, 1) 点在左下角，判定标出正确的格子：左上角往下一格。
chain.en: Following school geometry, the player picks (0, 1) at the bottom left; the verdict marks the right cell: one below the top-left corner.

chain.zh: 玩家对着坐标轴看出原点在左上角、y 向下；在宽高不等的图上点出 (2, 0) 在右上角，确认 x 是列。
chain.en: Reading the axes, the player sees the origin at the top left and y pointing down; on an image whose width and height differ, (2, 0) is the top-right cell, so x counts columns.

chain.zh: 第二个任务反过来写出高亮格子的坐标，把 x、y 写反的答案在宽高不等的图上判错。
chain.en: The second task goes the other way, writing the coordinates of a highlighted cell; an answer with x and y swapped fails on an image whose width and height differ.

naive.zh: y 轴朝上，或把 (x, y) 读成先行后列。
naive.en: y points up, or (x, y) is read as row, then column.

task.zh: 按数组下标 I[y, x] 点出像素，并从数组的形状写出图的宽和高。
task.en: Pick pixels by the array index I[y, x], and write an image's width and height from its array shape.

question.zh: 坐标 (x, y) 和数组下标 I[行, 列] 怎么对应？形状是 (2, 3) 的图有多宽？
question.en: How do coordinates (x, y) match the array index I[row, column]? How wide is an image of shape (2, 3)?

chain.zh: 玩家要点 I[1, 2]，照坐标的写法点了 (1, 2)，在 2 行高的图上出了界。
chain.en: Asked for I[1, 2], the player picks (1, 2) as if it were coordinates, which lies outside an image 2 rows high.

chain.zh: 改点第 1 行、第 2 列，和坐标 (2, 1) 是同一格：数组的第一个下标是 y。
chain.en: Picking row 1, column 2 lands on the cell at coordinates (2, 1): the array's first index is y.

chain.zh: 第二个任务给出形状 (2, 3)：写成宽 2、高 3 判错，玩家看出形状先写高；OpenCV 的尺寸 (宽, 高) 正好反过来。
chain.en: The second task gives the shape (2, 3): width 2, height 3 fails, and the player sees the shape lists height first, the reverse of OpenCV's size (width, height).

facet.zh: 从坐标换到数组下标：I[y, x] 先行后列，形状先高后宽，和 (宽, 高) 的尺寸写法相反
facet.en: From coordinates to array indices: I[y, x] puts the row first and the shape height first, the reverse of a (width, height) size

task.zh: 在针孔相机的台子上移动物体，让它的像落到像平面的标记处，再让像长到标记的高度。
task.en: On the pinhole camera bench, move the object so its image lands on the mark on the image plane, then so the image reaches the marked height.

question.zh: 场景里的一点穿过针孔，落在像平面的什么位置？同一个物体离得越远，像怎样变？
question.en: Where on the image plane does a scene point land after passing the pinhole? How does the image change as the object moves away?

chain.zh: 第一个任务只能横向移动物体：f = 2、Z = 4，标记在 u = 1；玩家把物体放在 X = 1，像落在 0.5，没到。
chain.en: The first task allows only sideways moves: with f = 2 and Z = 4 the mark is at u = 1; the player puts the object at X = 1 and its image lands at 0.5, short of it.

chain.zh: 玩家顺着画出的光线看：光线穿过针孔，位置按 f/Z 缩小了，X = 2 才对上。
chain.en: Following the drawn ray through the hole, the player sees the position shrunk by f/Z; only X = 2 hits the mark.

chain.zh: 第二个任务只能前后移动一支箭：箭退到两倍远，像高减半；玩家由此定出让像高等于标记的距离。
chain.en: The second task allows only moves in depth: when the arrow goes twice as far its image halves, and the player finds the distance at which the image matches the mark.

naive.zh: 以为像的位置就是物体的位置（u = X），和距离无关。
naive.en: Assume the image lands where the object is (u = X), whatever its distance.

task.zh: 物体和距离都固定，只调像平面的距离 f，让像高等于目标。
task.en: With the object and its distance fixed, adjust only the plane distance f so the image height matches the target.

question.zh: 物体不动、相机不挪，还有什么能让像变大？
question.en: With neither the object nor the camera moving, what else can make the image larger?

chain.zh: 玩家想去移动物体，这一关物体和距离都锁住了，只有 f 能动。
chain.en: The player reaches for the object, but object and distance are locked; only f moves.

chain.zh: 把 f 拉长，光线到更远处才落到像平面上，像变高；f 加倍，像高也加倍。
chain.en: Lengthening f makes the rays meet the plane farther back and the image grows; doubling f doubles it.

chain.zh: 下一组换了物高和距离，玩家先按 fH/Z 估出 f，再上台验证。
chain.en: The next set changes the object's height and distance, and the player estimates f from fH/Z before checking it on the bench.

facet.zh: 从改场景换成改相机：焦距 f 越长，像越大
facet.en: From changing the scene to changing the camera: the longer the focal length f, the larger the image

task.zh: 焦距固定，从几组（物高, 距离）里选出成像一样高、距离却不同的两组。
task.en: With the focal length fixed, pick from several (height, distance) pairs two that image equally tall at different distances.

question.zh: 看到像有多高，能定出物体有多远吗？
question.en: Does the height of an image tell how far away the object is?

chain.zh: 玩家选了像高相同的两组，其中一组和另一组距离相同，判定要求距离不同。
chain.en: The player picks two pairs with equal image heights but the same distance; the verdict asks for different distances.

chain.zh: 玩家找到物高和距离一起翻倍的两组：f = 2 时 (1, 2) 和 (2, 4) 的像高都是 1。
chain.en: The player finds pairs whose height and distance double together: at f = 2, (1, 2) and (2, 4) both image 1 tall.

chain.zh: 玩家看出像只定出 H/Z 的比，大而远和小而近拍出同一个像：投影丢掉了一维。
chain.en: The image fixes only the ratio H/Z, so large-and-far and small-and-near give the same image: projection lost a dimension.

facet.zh: 尺度和深度的歧义：像只定出 H/Z，定不出 H 和 Z 各是多少
facet.en: The scale–depth ambiguity: the image fixes only H/Z, not H and Z separately

task.zh: 在透镜的台子上调光圈和对焦距离，让进光量达到要求，同时让近处的物体清晰。
task.en: On the lens bench, set the aperture and the focus distance so the light meets the requirement and the near object is sharp.

question.zh: 要让图更亮又不变糊，只把小孔开大够吗？
question.en: To make the image brighter without blurring it, is widening the hole enough?

chain.zh: 玩家先把光圈开大：进光量够了，两个物体的模糊圈都变大，近处的物体不清晰。
chain.en: The player opens the aperture: the light is enough, but both objects' blur circles grow and the near object is not sharp.

chain.zh: 玩家转动对焦，转到近处物体的距离时它的模糊圈缩到门槛以下，远处的那个反而更糊。
chain.en: Turning the focus to the near object's distance shrinks its blur circle below the threshold, while the far one blurs more.

chain.zh: 玩家看出透镜把一个距离上的光会聚到一点：开大光圈换来亮度，靠对焦让选中的距离清晰。
chain.en: The player sees that a lens gathers the light from one distance to a point: the wide aperture buys light, and focusing makes the chosen distance sharp.

naive.zh: 只开大光圈、不对焦：亮度够了，物体却是糊的。
naive.en: Open the aperture without focusing: the light is enough but the object is blurred.

task.zh: 对焦距离固定，比较两档光圈下清晰的深度范围，再选出让近处和远处的标记都清晰的光圈。
task.en: With the focus fixed, compare the sharp depth ranges at two apertures, then choose an aperture that keeps both the near and the far marker sharp.

question.zh: 近处和远处两个物体，怎样在一张照片里都清晰？
question.en: How can a near and a far object both be sharp in one photo?

chain.zh: 玩家先把光圈开到最大，好让图亮：清晰范围收窄到对焦处附近，远处的标记糊了。
chain.en: The player opens the aperture fully for light: the sharp range narrows around the focus and the far marker blurs.

chain.zh: 收小光圈，模糊圈整体变小，曲线低于门槛的一段变宽，两个标记都进入清晰范围，进光量却下降。
chain.en: Closing the aperture shrinks every blur circle, the stretch of the curve below the threshold widens and both markers become sharp, while the light drops.

chain.zh: 台上同时给出 f 数 = 焦距 / 光圈直径：玩家看出 f 数越大，光圈越小，景深越大。
chain.en: The bench also shows the f-number = focal length / aperture diameter: the larger the f-number, the smaller the aperture and the deeper the sharp range.

naive.zh: 以为光圈只管亮度：开大光圈后，清晰的范围不变。
naive.en: Assume the aperture only sets brightness: opening it leaves the sharp range unchanged.

title.en: Sharp front to back, and bright enough

task.zh: 同时调光圈和对焦距离，让两个物体都清晰，进光量又不低于要求。
task.en: Set the aperture and the focus together so both objects are sharp and the light is not below the requirement.

question.zh: 既要两个深度都清晰，又要足够的光：对焦该放在哪里？
question.en: With both depths to keep sharp and enough light to gather, where should the focus go?

chain.zh: 玩家对焦在近处物体上，再收光圈直到两个都清晰，进光量却低于要求。
chain.en: The player focuses on the near object and closes the aperture until both are sharp, but the light falls below the requirement.

chain.zh: 玩家把对焦移到两个物体之间，清晰范围两边都用得上，光圈可以开得更大。
chain.en: Moving the focus between the two objects puts both sides of the sharp range to use, so the aperture can open wider.

chain.zh: 找到既够亮、两个都清晰的设置；只动一个旋钮的设置都过不了。
chain.en: The player finds a setting both bright enough and sharp for both; no setting that moves only one knob passes.

facet.zh: 光圈和对焦一起取舍：进光量和景深互相牵制
facet.en: Aperture and focus traded off together: light and depth of field pull against each other

task.zh: 传感器大小固定，调焦距让一排物体全部落在传感器上，再让指定的物体占满画面的高度。
task.en: With the sensor size fixed, set the focal length so a whole row of objects lands on the sensor, then so a given object fills the frame's height.

question.zh: 要把一排物体全拍进画面，焦距该变长还是变短？
question.en: To get a whole row of objects into the frame, should the focal length grow or shrink?

chain.zh: 玩家先把 f 拉长想看清楚些，两端的物体落到传感器边缘以外，台上标出它们不在画面里。
chain.en: The player lengthens f to see better, the outer objects fall beyond the sensor's edges, and the bench marks them out of view.

chain.zh: 缩短 f，所有物体都回到传感器上，但每一个都变小了。
chain.en: Shortening f brings every object back onto the sensor, each of them smaller.

chain.zh: 第二个任务要一个物体占满画面高度，玩家把 f 拉长；他看出焦距短视场宽，焦距长视场窄、物体显得大。
chain.en: The second task wants one object to fill the frame's height, and the player lengthens f: a short focal length sees wide, a long one narrow with objects looking larger.

naive.zh: 以为焦距越长，画面装下的东西越多。
naive.en: Assume a longer focal length fits more of the scene into the frame.

task.zh: 传感器高 20 mm、200 像素：由物体在图中占的像素、它的实际高度和距离，定出镜头的焦距，再写出以像素计的焦距。
task.en: The sensor is 20 mm and 200 pixels tall: from the pixels an object covers in the image, its real height and its distance, find the lens's focal length, then state it in pixels.

question.zh: 物体在图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm、离相机 600 mm：镜头的焦距是多少毫米？
question.en: An object is 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall and 600 mm from the camera: what is the lens's focal length in millimetres?

chain.zh: 玩家把 100 像素当成 100 mm 代进 h/f = H/Z，得到 500 mm；台上画出的像比整块传感器还高，对不上。
chain.en: Taking 100 pixels as 100 mm in h/f = H/Z, the player gets 500 mm; the bench draws an image taller than the whole sensor, which cannot be right.

chain.zh: 玩家先用传感器换算：200 像素对应 20 mm，100 像素就是 10 mm，代入得 f = 50 mm，像正好占传感器的一半高。
chain.en: Converting with the sensor first — 200 pixels are 20 mm, so 100 pixels are 10 mm — gives f = 50 mm, and the image covers exactly half the sensor's height.

chain.zh: 第二个任务问以像素计的焦距：50 mm 除以每像素 0.1 mm 得 500 像素，玩家再用它说出这台相机的视场有多宽。
chain.en: The second task asks for the focal length in pixels: 50 mm over 0.1 mm per pixel is 500 pixels, and the player uses it to say how wide this camera's field of view is.

naive.zh: 把像素数当成毫米，直接代进相似三角形。
naive.en: Put the pixel count straight into the similar triangles as millimetres.

task.zh: OpenCV 读进来的照片按 BGR 存：接一块电路，把它换成按 RGB 存的图。
task.en: A photo read by OpenCV is stored as BGR: wire a circuit that turns it into an image stored as RGB.

question.zh: 同一张照片，为什么在这里显示出橙色的天空？
question.en: Why does this photo show an orange sky here?

chain.zh: 玩家把输入直接接到输出，测试图的天空显示成橙色；第一个不同的格子里，期望和实际的第一个数和第三个数对调。
chain.en: Wiring the input straight to the output shows the test image's sky in orange; in the first differing cell, the first and third numbers of expected and actual are swapped.

chain.zh: 玩家用取通道把三个通道分别取出来看，第 0 个通道其实是蓝色。
chain.en: Taking the three channels out one by one with channel, the player sees that channel 0 is in fact blue.

chain.zh: 按 2、1、0 的顺序合成彩色图后通过；形状和每个像素的位置都没变，只是通道重排了。
chain.en: Composing them in the order 2, 1, 0 passes; the shape and every pixel's place are unchanged, only the channels are rearranged.

naive.zh: 以为通道一定按 RGB 排，原样输出。
naive.en: Assume the channels are always RGB and pass the image through unchanged.

task.zh: 对照一张图存着的数和它显示出的样子，填出每格显示的值；再把 OpenCV 读进来的几个 uint8 像素写成 [0, 1] 里的 (R, G, B)。
task.en: Compare an image's stored numbers with how it is displayed and fill in each cell's displayed value; then write a few uint8 pixels read by OpenCV as (R, G, B) in [0, 1].

question.zh: 两个像素看上去一样白，存着的数一样吗？
question.en: Two pixels look equally white: do they hold the same number?

chain.zh: 画面上 1.0 和 1.2 两格一样白；玩家照画面以为存的都是 1，看数才知道一格是 1.2。
chain.en: On screen the cells holding 1.0 and 1.2 look equally white; going by the picture the player takes both for 1, and the numbers show one holds 1.2.

chain.zh: 玩家填出显示值 [0, 0.5, 1]，存储值仍是 [−0.2, 0.5, 1.2]：显示截断了，数据没变。
chain.en: The player fills the displayed values [0, 0.5, 1] while the stored ones stay [−0.2, 0.5, 1.2]: the display clipped, the data did not change.

chain.zh: 第二个任务给 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 像素 [255, 51, 0]：玩家照写成 (1, 0.2, 0) 判错，按 BGR 顺序、除以 255 写成 (0, 0.2, 1) 才对；同一个像素可以按不同的范围、类型和通道顺序存。
chain.en: The second task gives the uint8 pixel [255, 51, 0] as read by OpenCV: writing (1, 0.2, 0) fails; reading it as BGR and dividing by 255 gives (0, 0.2, 1); one pixel can be stored in different ranges, types and channel orders.

naive.zh: 以为屏幕上看到的就是存着的数，显示时的截断改掉了数据。
naive.en: Assume the screen shows what is stored, so clipping for display changed the data.

task.zh: 先在格子上写出一行像素放大后每个新像素在原图里的坐标，再搭出采样网格：给定原图和新图的宽高，输出两张源坐标图。
task.en: First write in a grid where each new pixel of an enlarged row sits in the original, then build the sampling grid: given the original's and the new width and height, output the two source-coordinate images.

question.zh: 图像放大或缩小时，新图的每个像素对应原图的什么位置？
question.en: When an image is enlarged or shrunk, where in the original does each new pixel sit?

chain.zh: 格子题：2 像素宽放大到 3 像素，玩家写下 0、1、2，判定指出 2 已经在原图之外：新像素不是旧像素换了编号。
chain.en: The grid task enlarges a row 2 pixels wide to 3; the player writes 0, 1, 2, and the verdict notes that 2 lies outside the original: new pixels are not old ones renumbered.

chain.zh: 玩家把两排像素的中心对齐，新像素按 m/n 的比例落回原图，得到 −1/6、0.5、7/6：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
chain.en: Aligning the centres of the two rows maps the new pixels back by the ratio m/n to −1/6, 0.5 and 7/6: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

chain.zh: 电路里用坐标网格给出每个新像素的 x、y，再按比例映射回去；缩小成 1 像素的测试落在原图中心，同一块电路放大缩小都成立。
chain.en: In the circuit the coordinate grid gives each new pixel its x and y, which are mapped back by the ratio; a test shrinking to 1 pixel lands on the original's centre, and one circuit serves enlarging and shrinking alike.

naive.zh: 新图第 i 个像素就是原图第 i 个像素：放大时右边的新像素越出原图。
naive.en: New pixel i is old pixel i: when enlarging, the new pixels on the right run outside the original.

task.zh: 用采样网格搭出最近邻缩放：输入一张图和新的宽、高，输出缩放后的图。
task.en: Build nearest-neighbour resizing on the sampling grid: an image and a new width and height in, the resized image out.

question.zh: 放大一张图时，落在两个旧像素之间的新像素，值从哪里来？
question.en: When an image is enlarged, where does a new pixel that falls between two old ones get its value?

chain.zh: 玩家把源坐标直接向下取整去取像素：最左边的 −1/6 取成 −1，取像素出了界；中间的 0.5 取成 0。
chain.en: The player rounds the source coordinates down and reads there: the leftmost −1/6 becomes −1 and the lookup runs outside; the middle 0.5 becomes 0.

chain.zh: 改成取最近的整数（加 0.5 再向下取整）；0.5 离两边一样远，测试按约定要坐标较大的一边，[0, 1] 放大成 [0, 1, 1]。
chain.en: Rounding to the nearest whole number instead (add 0.5, then round down) — and 0.5 being equally far from both, the test takes the larger coordinate by convention — [0, 1] enlarges to [0, 1, 1].

chain.zh: 隐藏测试有缩小、尺寸不变和宽为 1 的情况，同一块电路都通过；放大后的图一块一块的。
chain.en: Hidden tests shrink, keep the size and make the width 1, and the same circuit passes them all; enlarged images come out blocky.

naive.zh: 源坐标一律向下取整：左端越界，一样远时又取了较小的一边。
naive.en: Always round the source coordinate down: the left end runs outside, and equal distances take the smaller side.

task.zh: 用最近邻缩放把细条纹图缩到一半宽，判断原图的哪些列在结果里留了下来。
task.en: Shrink a finely striped image to half its width with nearest-neighbour resizing, and judge which of the original's columns survive in the result.

question.zh: 最近邻缩小图像时，没被选中的旧像素去了哪里？
question.en: When nearest neighbour shrinks an image, what becomes of the old pixels it does not pick?

chain.zh: 玩家预测黑白相间的 [0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1] 缩到 4 格后还是黑白相间，输出却全是 1。
chain.en: The player predicts that the alternating row [0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1] stays alternating at 4 pixels; the output is all 1.

chain.zh: 玩家对照采样网格给出的源坐标，看出每个新像素只读了一列，另一半的列一个都没被读到。
chain.en: Comparing with the source coordinates from the sampling grid, the player sees each new pixel reads one column and half the columns are never read at all.

chain.zh: 换一张条纹更宽的图，缩小后条纹还在：最近邻缩小只是隔列取样，比取样间隔细的细节整个消失。
chain.en: With wider stripes the pattern survives the shrink: nearest-neighbour shrinking only samples every other column, and detail finer than the spacing vanishes entirely.

facet.zh: 缩小的方向：最近邻只挑出一部分旧像素，其余的值完全不参与，细条纹会消失
facet.en: The shrinking direction: nearest neighbour picks only some old pixels, the rest take no part at all, and fine stripes vanish

task.zh: 搭出线性缩放：输入一张图和新的宽、高，新像素的值由左右两个旧像素按距离加权（这一关的图只有一行）。
task.en: Build linear resizing: an image and a new width and height in, each new pixel weighted from the old pixels on its left and right by distance (this level's images are one row high).

question.zh: 新像素落在两个旧像素之间时，它只能等于其中一个吗？
question.en: When a new pixel falls between two old ones, must it equal one of them?

chain.zh: 玩家先接上最近邻缩放：[0, 1] 放大到 3 格，测试要中间是 0.5，最近邻只给得出 0 或 1。
chain.en: The player first wires in the nearest-neighbour resizer: [0, 1] enlarged to 3 must have 0.5 in the middle, and nearest neighbour can only give 0 or 1.

chain.zh: 玩家用向下取整找到左边的像素、再取右边那一个，用源坐标减去取整的结果得到到左边的距离 t。
chain.en: Rounding down finds the left pixel and the next one the right; the source coordinate less its rounded value gives the distance t from the left.

chain.zh: 按 1 − t 和 t 加权后中间得到 0.5；两端的源坐标落在原图之外，取像素设成取最近的边，端点仍是 0 和 1。
chain.en: Weighting by 1 − t and t gives 0.5 in the middle; the end coordinates fall outside the original, and with the lookup set to the nearest edge the ends stay 0 and 1.

naive.zh: 照抄最近的那个旧像素（最近邻），中间那格只能是 0 或 1。
naive.en: Copy the nearest old pixel (nearest neighbour), so the middle can only be 0 or 1.

task.zh: 把线性缩放升级成双线性：新像素的值由周围四个旧像素加权得到。
task.en: Upgrade linear resizing to bilinear: a new pixel's value is weighted from the four old pixels around it.

question.zh: 在二维图像里，落在四个旧像素中间的新像素，值怎么算？
question.en: In a 2D image, how is the value of a new pixel among four old ones computed?

chain.zh: 沿用只沿行插值的电路，[[0, 1], [1, 0]] 放大成 3×3：竖直方向没有插值，中间一行照抄了某一行，和测试的中心 0.5 不同。
chain.en: The row-only circuit enlarges [[0, 1], [1, 0]] to 3×3 with no vertical interpolation: the middle row copies one of the rows and misses the test's centre of 0.5.

chain.zh: 玩家对 y 也算出距离 V，先沿 x 在上下两行各插一次，再沿 y 把两个结果插值。
chain.en: The player works out the vertical distance V as well, interpolates along x on the rows above and below, then along y between the two results.

chain.zh: 展开后四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV，和为 1；非正方形的图和边界上的隐藏测试都通过。
chain.en: Expanded, the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV, summing to 1; hidden tests with non-square images and borders pass.

naive.zh: 只沿横向插值，竖直方向照抄最近的一行。
naive.en: Interpolate along x only and copy the nearest row vertically.

task.zh: 用最近邻和双线性放大同一张图，把两个结果配给给出的剖面，再判断「双线性总是更好」这句话。
task.en: Enlarge one image with nearest neighbour and with bilinear, match the two results to the given profiles, then judge the claim 'bilinear is always better'.

question.zh: 最近邻和双线性放大同一张图，结果差在哪里？哪一种总是更好？
question.en: How do nearest-neighbour and bilinear enlargements of one image differ, and is one always better?

chain.zh: 玩家把一行 [0, 1] 用两个元件各放大到 5 格：一个给出台阶，一个给出斜坡，各配一条剖面。
chain.en: The player enlarges the row [0, 1] to 5 with both parts: one gives a step, the other a ramp, each matched to a profile.

chain.zh: 换成一张有锐利黑白边的图：双线性在边上造出了原图没有的灰色，最近邻保住了硬边，却一块一块的。
chain.en: On an image with a sharp black-and-white edge, bilinear creates greys the original never had, while nearest neighbour keeps the edge hard but blocky.

chain.zh: 判断「双线性总是更好」时，玩家拿这条边当反例：要保住硬边时最近邻更合适，没有一种插值对每个任务都最好。
chain.en: Judging 'bilinear is always better', the player cites this edge as a counterexample: where hard edges matter nearest neighbour fits better, and no interpolation is best for every task.

facet.zh: 取舍：最近邻快、边硬、成块，双线性平滑却把锐边变软；没有一种方法总是最好
facet.en: The trade-off: nearest neighbour is fast with hard, blocky edges, bilinear smooth but softening sharp edges; no method is always best

task.zh: 搭出量化器：输入一张值可能越界的图和级数 L，先截到 [0, 1]，再存成最近的一级。
task.en: Build a quantiser: an image whose values may leave the range and a number of levels L in; clip to [0, 1], then store the nearest level.

question.zh: 一个值只能存成 L 级中的一级时，该存哪一级？
question.en: When a value can only be stored as one of L levels, which level should it be?

chain.zh: 玩家把值乘以 L − 1 后直接向下取整：L = 3 时 0.8 存成了 0.5，离它更近的是 1。
chain.en: The player multiplies by L − 1 and rounds down: with L = 3, 0.8 is stored as 0.5 although 1 is nearer.

chain.zh: 改成取最近的一级（加 0.5 再向下取整）；0.75 正好在两级中间，按约定存成较大的一级。
chain.en: Taking the nearest level instead (add 0.5, then round down), 0.75 lies exactly between two levels and by convention goes to the larger.

chain.zh: 隐藏测试里有 −0.2 和 1.3，算出了不存在的级；玩家用取大、取小把值截到 [0, 1] 后通过。
chain.en: Hidden tests include −0.2 and 1.3, which give levels that do not exist; clipping to [0, 1] with max and min makes them pass.

naive.zh: 乘以级数后直接截掉小数（向下取整），不取最近的一级。
naive.en: Multiply by the levels and cut off the fraction (round down) instead of taking the nearest level.

task.zh: 用量化器把一张图存成 3 级，再判断能不能从结果唯一地找回原来的值。
task.en: Store an image in 3 levels with the quantiser, then judge whether the original values can be recovered uniquely from the result.

question.zh: 量化以后，原来的值还能找回来吗？
question.en: After quantisation, can the original values be recovered?

chain.zh: 玩家把 [0.1, 0.2] 存成 3 级，两个都变成 0。
chain.en: The player stores [0.1, 0.2] in 3 levels and both become 0.

chain.zh: 判断「从量化结果能唯一地找回原值」时，玩家选了能，判定给出两个不同的输入和同一个输出。
chain.en: Judging 'the original can be recovered uniquely from the quantised result', the player says yes, and the verdict shows two different inputs with one output.

chain.zh: 玩家改判不能；隐藏的一轮换了 L，级数越少，落进同一级的值越多。
chain.en: The player changes the answer to no; a hidden round changes L, and the fewer the levels, the more values share one.

facet.zh: 量化不可逆：不同的值落进同一级，存下的级数不等于原来的精度
facet.en: Quantisation cannot be undone: different values fall into one level, and the stored levels are not the original precision

task.zh: 搭出裁剪：输入一张图、窗口左上角的 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出窗口里的那一块。
task.en: Build cropping: an image, the window's top-left x0, y0 and its width w and height h in, the block inside the window out.

question.zh: 从一张图里取出一块时，输出的像素值是原图里已有的，还是新算出来的？
question.en: When a block is taken out of an image, are the output's pixel values ones the original holds, or newly computed?

chain.zh: 玩家先用手上的缩放元件把整张图缩成 2×2：输出是整张图上取的样，测试要的是从 (1, 0) 起那一块原样的值。
chain.en: The player first shrinks the whole image to 2×2 with a resizer in hand: the output samples the whole image, while the test wants the block from (1, 0) with its values unchanged.

chain.zh: 玩家看出窗口里每个输出像素就是原图里错开 (x0, y0) 的那个像素：坐标网格加上偏移，再取像素。
chain.en: The player sees that each output pixel is the original pixel offset by (x0, y0): the coordinate grid plus the offset, then a lookup.

chain.zh: 隐藏测试有贴边的窗口和 1×1 的窗口，值都原样保留：裁剪不算新值，缩放才要算。
chain.en: Hidden tests include windows on the border and 1×1 windows, all values kept as they are: cropping computes nothing new; resizing must.

naive.zh: 把整张图缩小到要的尺寸当作裁剪。
naive.en: Shrink the whole image to the requested size and call it a crop.

task.zh: 把任意大小的照片做成 S×S 的输入：先按同一个比例缩放，让短边等于 S，再从中间裁出 S×S。
task.en: Turn a photo of any size into an S×S input: scale it by one factor so the short side is S, then crop S×S from the middle.

question.zh: 网络要 512×512 的输入，手里是 768×512 的照片：直接缩放到 512×512 可以吗？
question.en: A network wants 512×512 input and the photo is 768×512: can it simply be resized to 512×512?

chain.zh: 玩家直接把照片缩放成 S×S，测试图里的圆变成了椭圆，输出和要求不同。
chain.en: The player resizes the photo straight to S×S; the circle in the test image becomes an ellipse and the output differs from the requirement.

chain.zh: 玩家用尺寸和取小找出短边，宽和高乘同一个比例再缩放，圆仍然是圆。
chain.en: Finding the short side with size and min, the player scales width and height by one factor, and the circle stays a circle.

chain.zh: 再按 ⌊(W − S)/2⌋、⌊(H − S)/2⌋ 算出中心窗口的起点，用裁剪取出 S×S；横幅和竖幅的隐藏测试都通过。
chain.en: The centre window's corner from ⌊(W − S)/2⌋ and ⌊(H − S)/2⌋ and a crop give S×S; hidden tests in landscape and portrait pass.

naive.zh: 宽和高各缩各的，直接缩放到 S×S，宽高比变了。
naive.en: Scale width and height separately straight to S×S, changing the aspect ratio.

task.zh: 输出和输入一样大的图，显示原图中心那一块放大 k 倍后的样子。
task.en: Output an image as large as the input, showing the block at the original's centre magnified k times.

question.zh: 手机的「数码变焦」没有换镜头，它是怎样把画面中间放大的？
question.en: A phone's digital zoom changes no lens: how does it magnify the middle of the picture?

chain.zh: 玩家先把整张图放大 k 倍，再用原来的坐标从 (0, 0) 裁出原尺寸：得到的是左上角，第一个不同的格子就在左上。
chain.en: The player enlarges the whole image k times, then crops the original size from (0, 0) as before: the result is the top-left corner, and the first differing cell is right there.

chain.zh: 玩家看出放大以后坐标也放大了 k 倍；隐藏测试换了非正方形的图和 k，中心窗口要按宽和高各自算。
chain.en: The player sees that enlarging scaled the coordinates by k too; hidden tests change to non-square images and other k, so the centre window must be worked out for width and height separately.

chain.zh: 跳跃在于先裁后放：在原图的坐标里从中心裁出 W/k × H/k，再放大回 W × H，宽高比不变，也不用先造一张 k² 倍大的图。
chain.en: The leap is to crop first: in the original's coordinates take W/k × H/k from the centre, then enlarge back to W × H, keeping the aspect ratio and never building an image k² times as large.

naive.zh: 先把整张图放大，再按原来的数裁同样的窗口：坐标没跟着放大，裁到的是左上角。
naive.en: Enlarge the whole image, then crop the same window by the old numbers: the coordinates were not scaled, so the crop lands in the top-left corner.

about.zh: 针孔参数台加一个可选的传感器（高、宽各以毫米和像素给出，主点在中心）：在像平面上画出它的边，标出哪些物体落在边外、不在画面里，像的位置和高度同时以毫米和像素读出，目标可以用像素给出；台子可以放几个横向位置不同的物体。
about.en: Give the pinhole bench an optional sensor (height and width in millimetres and in pixels, principal point at its centre): draw its edges on the image plane, mark which objects fall beyond them and are out of view, read image positions and heights in both millimetres and pixels, allow targets in pixels, and allow several objects at different lateral positions.

note.zh: 针孔台的 setup 加了 objects（几支箭，各从 X 到 X + H，可各有深度）和 sensor（height、width 毫米，pxHeight、pxWidth 像素，主点在中心）；读数多了 u_px、h_px、各物体的 u_<id>、h_<id>、in_<id>（及 _px）、inView、allIn、fpx、fov、fovW；target.of 可以是 u_px、h_px。侧视图画出传感器的边，出画的物体虚着画并标出（games/DESIGN.md 6.8）。
note.en: The pinhole setup gains objects (arrows from X to X + H, each at its own depth or the knob Z) and sensor (height, width in mm; pxHeight, pxWidth in pixels; principal point at the centre); readings add u_px, h_px, each object's u_<id>, h_<id>, in_<id> (and _px), inView, allIn, fpx, fov, fovW; target.of may be u_px or h_px. The side view draws the sensor's edges and dashes and marks what falls out of view (games/DESIGN.md 6.8).

about.zh: 第 2 章起的各章：滤波与卷积、频率与混叠、成像 II（明暗与颜色）、CNN 与表示学习、特征与匹配、深度与双视几何、生成模型、分割与检测
about.en: The chapters from 2 on: filtering and convolution, frequency and aliasing, image formation II (shading and colour), CNNs and representation learning, features and matching, depth and two-view geometry, generative models, segmentation and detection

why.zh: 本次范围只到第 0、1 章；第 1 章的工作台缺的正是邻域运算，下一章由此开始。
why.en: This run covers chapters 0 and 1 only; what chapter 1's workbench lacks is neighbourhood operations, which is where the next chapter starts.

about.zh: 平移（含出界时补 0 或取边的约定）
about.en: Translation (with its zero or edge policy outside the image)

why.zh: 章节规格把它放在第 1 章，但这里只有一道拼凑的「先平移再裁剪」用它；它第一次非有不可是滤波，把错开的几份图加权相加，放到那一章搭。
why.en: The chapter specification put it in chapter 1, where only a contrived 'translate then crop' level used it; it first becomes indispensable in filtering, which sums weighted shifted copies, so it is built there.

about.zh: 缩小时的抗混叠，JPEG 先丢高频细节
about.en: Anti-aliasing when shrinking, and JPEG discarding high-frequency detail first

why.zh: 两者都要频率的概念（第 4 讲）；第 1 章只让玩家看到最近邻缩小会丢掉细条纹，不声称这个问题已经解决。
why.en: Both need the idea of frequency (lecture 4); chapter 1 only shows nearest-neighbour shrinking losing fine stripes and does not claim the problem solved.

about.zh: 镜头畸变（桶形畸变）和真实相机的内参（主点偏移、像素不是正方形）
about.en: Lens distortion (barrel distortion) and a real camera's intrinsics (principal point offsets, non-square pixels)

why.zh: 讲义只定性地提到，领域没有对应的模型；放到相机几何一章。
why.en: The lecture mentions them only qualitatively and the domain has no model for them; they belong to the camera geometry chapter.

about.zh: uint8 运算的溢出（workshop 里把红色通道换成绿、蓝的平均）
about.en: Overflow in uint8 arithmetic (the workshop's red channel set to the mean of green and blue)

why.zh: 领域的值是实数，计算里不截断，无从演示溢出；数值范围一关只讲存储和显示的区别。
why.en: The domain's values are real numbers that are never truncated in computation, so overflow cannot be shown; the value-range level covers only storage against display.

about.zh: 渲染再比较（render and compare）作为一种估计方法
about.en: Render and compare as an estimation method

why.zh: 第 0 章的玩家已经在转视角、和候选图比较时手动做过；把它做成会迭代修正的估计器，要等能优化参数的那一章。
why.en: Chapter 0's player already does it by hand when turning the view to match a candidate; making it an estimator that corrects itself waits for the chapter that can optimise parameters.
